ValidationRule.description: CustomLabels should not be committed to a User Story.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND ( OR( AND(PRIORVALUE(copado__Promote_Change__c) = false,copado__Promote_Change__c = true), AND(PRIORVALUE(copado__Promote_and_Deploy__c) = false,copado__Promote_and_Deploy__c = true)),
OR( INCLUDES(copado__Metadata_Types_in_Selection__c , "CustomLabels"), of_CustomLabels__c > 0 ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The "CustomLabels" file should not be committed to a User Story. Please remove "CustomLabels" by recommitting and recreating feature branch.
